Composer.note: The full composer the surface hosts: textarea frame, control row, send. The surface's own paint (composer background, 0.5px stroke, 20px --radius-composer) is visible against the page.

EmptyPlaceholder.note: Resting composer with placeholder copy and a minimal control row.

ScrollingDraft.note: Default overflowMode='auto' bounded by an inline maxHeight: the draft is visibly clipped at the surface edge, which is the only still-frame evidence the scroll container works.
